# Studio methods (generated reference)

84 methods of a live Blender session (`satk blender call <method> --params JSON`). One line each: **bold** = required, `name=default`, `(a|b)` = allowed values; `object|objects` = one name or a list of names/globs. Mesh edits also take a face selector `select` (`side`, `normal`+`within`, `where`, `box`, `group`, `material`). `satk blender methods --query <name>` gives the full help of one method.

| method | ro | parameters | what it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `camera.add` |  | **name**, location, target=[0.0, 0.0, 0.0], ortho=false, ortho_scale=5.0, lens=50.0, view="3q", margin=S.MARGIN, fit | Add or re-frame a named camera: view (front\|rear\|left\|right\|top\|3q) fitted to 'fit' objects, or location+target. |
| `camera.list` | ro | - | Cameras of the scene with their view, type and position. |
| `camera.views` |  | views=["front", "left", "top", "3q"], prefix="cam_", fit | Add (or re-frame) cameras cam_<view> for views (default front, left, top, 3q) fitted to 'fit' objects. |
| `io.ghost` |  | replace=true, offset, plan, dff, txd=[], sid | Import a vanilla model (sid) or a DFF as a ghost reference (never counted or exported); offset, replace. |
| `io.import` |  | plan, dff, txd=[], sid | Import a DFF (+TXD; the sibling .txd is found) to keep editing it: dff path, txd path(s), sid via the client. |
| `kit.adopt` |  | collection, kind, name=coll.name[:-4], tier="vanilla" | Make an imported DFF collection a kit model (tags frames, slots and its collision) so kit.shade/kit.export work on it. |
| `kit.bake` |  | **object**, size=256, samples=16, radius=0.03, gain=6.0 | Cycles bake of ambient occlusion and a Bevel-node edge mask into PNGs (object UVs; size = N, [w, h] or 'WxH' px). |
| `kit.blank` |  | plan, plan_data, model, replace, split, fill | Build the blank of a plan file (kit.blank op): the half body with a MIRROR modifier, the part boundaries as a face attribute, an interior piece; split=true cuts the parts out at once. |
| `kit.blank_split` |  | model="", object, keep, fill | Apply the MIRROR modifier of a blank body and cut it into its parts along the face attribute (doors per side) as <model>_<part> objects; fill=true moves them into the kit slots (kit.fill). |
| `kit.col` |  | model, shadow_faces=280, mode="hull", surface=0, max_faces=256 | Collision in Blender: a closed shadow mesh for vehicles, hull/box/mesh with face light for world models. |
| `kit.damage` |  | model, depth=0.14, sag=6.0, seed=1, min_p90=0.12, max_depth=0.35, parts=[] | Fill every *_dam slot from its *_ok twin: smooth dents, hinge sag, shattered glass; _dam/_ok triangles 1.0, displacement p90 >= 0.12 m. |
| `kit.export` |  | model, **out**, prelight="auto", stem, col="auto", textures=true | Export the kit model: DFF (frame-local spheres, embedded COL for vehicles), own-texture PNGs (kit.export op packs the TXD). |
| `kit.fill` |  | **slot**, **objects**, append, keep | Move modelling objects into a kit slot (joined in the slot's space, modifiers applied); sources are deleted unless keep=true. |
| `kit.info` | ro | model | The kit model: kind, tier, slots with triangles (empty ones listed), materials, COL objects, LOD. |
| `kit.lod` |  | model, ratio=0.21 | Fill a building's LOD slot (lod<name[3:]>) from the HD mesh at about 0.21 of its triangles. |
| `kit.material_preset` |  | **object**, **role**, model=coll.get('satk_name') if coll is not ..., image, slot="append" | Assign a material preset (paint1, glass, lamp_fl, map, ...) to an object's slot; image= sets an own texture from a PNG. |
| `kit.shade` |  | objects, model, check=true, class, weld=0.0005, weighted=true, smooth, hard, seams, materials | sa_shade in the fixed order (weld, smooth, sharp by the class rule, Weighted Normal last) + DFF re-read check (K1). |
| `kit.template` |  | **plan**, replace, textures | Scaffold a new asset from a template plan file (kit.template op): frames in vanilla order, empty slots, presets, COL skeleton. |
| `kit.uv_region` |  | **object**, **region**, project="auto", margin=0.03, faces | Project faces (all, role:<role>, material:<i>) into a named atlas region (satk kit kinds --atlas) at its measured place. |
| `kit.vlo` |  | model, target="", tris_max=130, sources | Fill the vehicle *_vlo slot from the undamaged body (chassis + *_ok parts, no wheels): at most 130 triangles. |
| `kit.wheel` |  | model, tier, slot="wheel", diameter, sides=12 if tier == 'vanilla' else 20, width=round(diameter * 0.36, 3), tyre=1 | Build the wheel into the kit's 'wheel' slot: diameter = wheel_scale, 12 sides (vanilla) or 20 (sa_plus); tyre UVs on vehicletyres128. |
| `look.apply` |  | look="game", lights="off", dirt=G.DIRT_DEFAULT, time="12:00", weather=G.DEFAULT_WEATHER | Give the scene an SA look: game (glass, white lamps, dirt 0-16, env, prelight), clay, wire or raw. |
| `look.preview` | ro | spec | Preview job (satk blender preview session:NAME): the scene next to imported peers, cells as PNG files. |
| `look.render` | ro | views=["3q", "side"], size=384, look="game", lights="off", dirt=G.DIRT_DEFAULT, time="12:00", weather=G.DEFAULT_WEATHER | Render views (3q rear3q front rear side top) in a look into one JPEG sheet; the look is restored. |
| `look.restore` |  | - | Undo look.apply: original materials, visibility, no ground. |
| `material.assign` |  | **material**, **object\|objects**, select | Give objects a material (all faces), or only the faces chosen by 'select' (a new slot when needed). |
| `material.create` |  | **name**, preset, color=[200, 200, 200], alpha, texture, objects=p.get('object'), object | Create (or update) a material: name, color (#RRGGBB or 0-255 list), alpha 0-255, texture (image path), preset. |
| `material.list` | ro | object | Materials of the scene (or of one object): colour 0-255, texture, users. |
| `material.set` |  | **name**, color, alpha, texture | Change a material's color, alpha (0-255) or texture (image path). |
| `mesh.bevel` |  | **object**, **width**, segments=1, profile=0.5, select, save_group, by=default_by, angle=30.0 | Bevel edges of the selection (by angle\|all\|boundary\|sharp\|seam\|material; width m, segments, profile). |
| `mesh.bisect` |  | **object**, axis="x" (x\|y\|z), at=0.0, keep="both" (+\|-\|both), fill=false | Cut the mesh with an axis plane (axis, at) and keep '+', '-' or both sides (fill closes the cut). |
| `mesh.bridge` |  | **object**, with, select, twist=0, cuts=0 | Bridge two open edge loops of a mesh (join 'with' objects into it first); cuts adds loops in the bridge. |
| `mesh.convert` |  | **object** | Turn a curve or text object into a mesh object of the same name (its modifiers applied). |
| `mesh.curve` |  | points, kind="poly" (poly\|smooth), name="curve", resolution=4, bevel_depth=0.0, bevel_resolution=2, fill_caps=true, closed=false, collection | Add a curve through points (kind poly\|smooth, closed, bevel_depth for tubes): rails, pipes, CURVE targets. |
| `mesh.delete` |  | **object**, select | Delete the selected faces (and the edges and vertices only they used). |
| `mesh.dissolve` |  | **object**, angle=1.0, delimit=["material", "uv", "sharp", "seam"], select | Limited dissolve below angle (deg, default 1 = planar only); delimit keeps material/uv/sharp/seam borders. |
| `mesh.extrude` |  | **object**, distance, vector, individual=false, select, save_group | Extrude the selected faces (select) by distance along their normal or by a vector; individual per face; a free sheet becomes a closed slab. |
| `mesh.group` |  | **object**, **name**, mode="replace" (replace\|add\|remove), select | Store the vertices of the selected faces as a vertex group (mode replace\|add\|remove) to address them later. |
| `mesh.info` | ro | **object** | Topology of one mesh: counts, open/non-manifold edges, sharp/seam edges, groups, materials, UV maps, bbox. |
| `mesh.inset` |  | **object**, **thickness**, depth=0.0, individual=false, select, save_group | Inset the selected faces by thickness (depth moves them in/out); the inner faces can be saved as a group; a thickness that would collapse the faces is an error. |
| `mesh.lathe` |  | **profile**, **segments**, axis="z" (x\|y\|z), angle=360.0, name="lathe", cap=false, collection, location | Spin a profile [[r, h], ...] around an axis into a new mesh (wheels, posts, barrels): segments required; UVs: u around, v along the profile. |
| `mesh.loft` |  | axis="y" (x\|y\|z), sections, **samples**, closed=true, mirror=false, cap=closed, name="loft", collection | Skin a new mesh through sections along an axis: sections=[{at, points:[[a,b],..]}], samples, mirror, cap. |
| `mesh.loopcut` |  | **object**, axis="y" (x\|y\|z), select, at, fractions, **count** | Cut edge loops across the mesh at exact positions along an axis: at=[..] (m), fractions=[0-1] or count. |
| `mesh.mark` |  | **object**, kind="sharp" (sharp\|seam), clear=false, select, by=default_by, angle=30.0 | Mark edges sharp or seam (kind) by angle\|material\|uv\|boundary\|all on the selection; clear=true unmarks. |
| `mesh.merge` |  | **object**, dist=0.0001, select | Merge vertices closer than dist (m, default 0.0001) on the selection (weld). |
| `mesh.normals` |  | **object**, mode="outside" (outside\|inside\|flip), select | Recalculate face normals outside (default) or inside, or flip them, on the selection. |
| `mesh.primitive` |  | kind, location=[0.0, 0.0, 0.0], rotation=[0.0, 0.0, 0.0], name=kind, collection, x_segments=1, y_segments=1, radius=0.5, radius_top=0, cap="ngon", **segments**, depth=1.0, **rings**, **subdivisions** | Add a primitive with explicit density: plane, grid (x/y_segments), cube, cylinder/cone/circle (segments), uv_sphere (segments, rings), ico_sphere (subdivisions). |
| `mesh.solidify` |  | **object**, **thickness**, offset=-1.0, even=true, select | Give a whole shell or free sheet thickness as real geometry (thickness m, offset -1 inward .. 1 outward, even): a closed shell with rim faces and UVs. |
| `mesh.subdivide` |  | **object**, cuts=1, select, smooth=0.0 | Subdivide the edges of the selected faces (cuts, smooth 0-1); grid fill keeps quads. |
| `mesh.symmetrize` |  | **object**, source="+x", dist=0.0001 | Make the mesh symmetric: copy the 'source' side (+x default) onto the other side of the axis plane. |
| `mesh.transform` |  | **object**, translate, rotate, scale, select, pivot | Move/rotate/scale the vertices of the selected faces (translate, rotate deg, scale; pivot median\|bounds\|origin). |
| `modifier.add` |  | **type**, **object\|objects**, settings="{}", name=kind.lower(), index | Add a whitelisted modifier (type, settings, name, index) to objects; see the module doc for the settings. |
| `modifier.apply` |  | **object\|objects**, all=false, **name** | Apply a modifier (name) or the whole stack (all=true) to the mesh; shared meshes are refused. |
| `modifier.list` | ro | **object** | The modifier stack of an object: name, type and the main settings. |
| `modifier.remove` |  | **object\|objects**, all=false, **name** | Remove a modifier (name) or all of them (all=true) from objects. |
| `modifier.set` |  | **object**, **name**, settings, index, show | Change settings of a modifier (object, name, settings) or move it in the stack (index). |
| `python` |  | code, args="{}" | Run Python code in the scene (bpy, bmesh, mathutils, ctx, args; fill 'result'); journaled + checkpoint. |
| `ref.list` | ro | - | Reference planes: name, view, image, size in metres. |
| `ref.plane` |  | **view**, **image**, width, **points**, **distance**, origin_px=[w / 2, h / 2], offset, name=f'ref_{view}', alpha=0.6, camera=true | Put a photo behind the model for a view (front\|rear\|left\|right\|top): image, width m or points+distance, origin_px. |
| `scene.clear` |  | match="*" | Delete objects (all, or those whose name matches the glob 'match') and the data nothing uses any more. |
| `scene.collection` |  | **name**, parent, objects, link=false | Create a collection (under 'parent') and/or move objects into it (objects; link=true keeps old links). |
| `scene.delete` |  | **object\|objects** | Delete the named objects (globs allowed); children keep their world position. |
| `scene.duplicate` |  | **object**, linked=false, mirror (x\|y\|z), name=f'{o.name}_copy', offset | Copy an object (name, offset [x,y,z], mirror x\|y\|z flips it across the origin plane; linked shares the mesh). |
| `scene.empty` |  | **name**, display="plain_axes", size=0.1, collection, parent, location=[0.0, 0.0, 0.0], rotation=[0.0, 0.0, 0.0] | Add an empty (frame/dummy): name, location, rotation (deg), parent, display (plain_axes\|cube\|sphere), size. |
| `scene.info` | ro | limit=50, match="*" | List the objects of the scene: name, type, triangles, dimensions, parent (match = glob, limit). |
| `scene.join` |  | **object\|objects**, into | Join mesh objects into the first one ('objects'; or 'into' + 'objects'). |
| `scene.object` | ro | **object** | One object in detail: transform (deg), dimensions, parent, children, collections, modifiers, materials, props. |
| `scene.origin` |  | **object**, to="bounds" | Move an object's origin without moving its mesh: to bounds centre, bottom centre, or a point [x,y,z]. |
| `scene.parent` |  | **object\|objects**, parent | Parent objects to 'parent' (null = unparent), keeping their world transform. |
| `scene.props` |  | **object\|objects**, set | Set custom properties on objects (values: number or string; null removes the key). |
| `scene.rename` |  | **object**, **name** | Rename an object (and its mesh data); NOT_READY if the new name is taken. |
| `scene.stats` | ro | objects="*", precise=false, file=false | Stats now without changing anything: tris, verts, dims, K1 shading metrics of objects (glob); file=true -> JSON. |
| `scene.transform` |  | **object\|objects**, location, rotation, scale, delta=false, apply=false, apply_location=false | Set or offset location/rotation(deg)/scale of objects; apply=true bakes rotation+scale into the mesh. |
| `scene.visible` |  | **object\|objects**, hide=false | Show or hide objects in snapshots and the viewport (hide=true\|false). |
| `session.checkpoint` | ro | tag | Save a checkpoint now (tag = a gate name such as G1; tagged checkpoints are never pruned). |
| `session.checkpoints` | ro | limit=20 | List the checkpoints of this session (step, tag, size). |
| `session.journal` | ro | last=10 | The last steps of the journal: n, method, ok, changed objects, checkpoint (last = how many). |
| `session.prune` | ro | keep=KEEP_CHECKPOINTS | Delete old untagged checkpoints, keeping the last 'keep' (default 10) and every tagged one. |
| `session.restore` |  | ref="last" | Replace the scene by a checkpoint (ref = step number, tag or 'last'); later steps stay in the journal. |
| `shade.basic` |  | **object\|objects**, mode="smooth" (smooth\|flat\|angle), angle=30.0, keep_sharp=true | Shade objects smooth, flat, or smooth by angle (mode, angle deg default 30, keep_sharp keeps marked edges). |
| `uv.fit` |  | **object**, **rect**, keep_aspect=false, layer, select | Scale and move the UVs of the selected faces into rect [u0, v0, u1, v1] (an atlas region); keep_aspect=true keeps the shape (default false: the island fills the rect). |
| `uv.layers` |  | **object**, add, copy=true, remove, active | Add, rename, remove or activate UV maps (add=name, remove=name, active=name); vehicles use a 2nd map for env. |
| `uv.texel` | ro | **object**, px | Texel density of an object in px/m (p10/p50/p90 over faces, area-weighted); texture size from its image or 'px' (N, [w, h] or 'WxH'). |
| `uv.unwrap` |  | **object**, method="smart", layer, select, axis="z" (x\|y\|z), size=1.0, margin=0.02, angle=66.0 | UV-unwrap the selected faces: method smart\|seams\|cube\|cylinder\|sphere\|planar (axis x\|y\|z for planar and cylinder, size m), layer, margin; cylinder keeps every face off the seam. |
